blocks.text: Welcome to Kingdom Heights Preparatory School, Military Families!

Kingdom Heights Preparatory School is proud to support military-connected students and families. Located minutes from Redstone Arsenal , we understand the unique challenges military families face, including frequent relocations, deployments, and transitions between school systems.
Our goal is simple: to provide stability, belonging, and excellence for students whose families serve our nation.
We work to ensure that military-connected students experience:

items: A smooth transition into our academic and spiritual community
Faculty and staff who understand military life and culture
Clear communication and support during deployments or relocations
Connection to trusted local resources in the Huntsville area

blocks.text: Whether your family is stationed here temporarily or long-term, you belong at Kingdom Heights Preparatory School.
Kingdom Heights Preparatory School designates a staff member to serve as a Military Family Liaison , available to assist with:

items: Social and emotional support during deployment cycles
Connecting families to local military resources

items.title: North Huntsville
items.text: Moores Mill & Meridianville North Huntsville is a rapidly growing area that appeals to families seeking newer homes, more land, and quieter suburban living, while still maintaining access to Redstone Arsenal and downtown Huntsville. - Expanding residential developments - Short commute via Highway 231/431 - Close to parks, greenways, and outdoor recreation - Popular with families planning longer-term stays

items.title: Hazel Green
items.text: Located just north of Huntsville, Hazel Green is known for its open spaces, family-friendly atmosphere, and growing residential developments. It is a popular choice for families looking for affordability and room to grow. - Larger lots and newer subdivisions - Easy access to North Huntsville and Meridianville - Slower pace with a strong sense of community - Ideal for families who enjoy a quieter lifestyle

items.title: Madison
items.text: Madison is one of the most popular areas for military families due to its central location and access to major commuting routes. - Family-friendly neighborhoods - Convenient access to Redstone Arsenal - Shopping, dining, and community amenities - Mix of established and newer developments

items.title: Hampton Cove
items.text: Hampton Cove is a master-planned community located in Southeast Huntsville, known for its scenic setting and outdoor lifestyle. - Parks, trails, and green spaces - Neighborhood pools and recreation areas - Easy access to downtown Huntsville and surrounding areas - Strong sense of community

items.title: Owens Cross Roads
items.text: Owens Cross Roads Owens Cross Roads offers quieter suburban living near Monte Sano and other outdoor recreation areas, appealing to families who value space and natural surroundings. - Peaceful neighborhoods near hiking and greenways - Short drive to Huntsville and Redstone Arsenal - Family-oriented atmosphere - Mix of new and established homes

items.title: South Huntsville
items.text: South Huntsville combines established neighborhoods with convenient access to major roadways, parks, and daily amenities. - Close to Arsenal gates and Memorial Parkway - Mature trees and established communities - Access to hiking, parks, and outdoor activities - Balanced suburban lifestyle

items.title: Harvest
items.text: Harvest is a growing community west of Huntsville that attracts families looking for more space and affordability while remaining connected to the city. - Larger lots and newer subdivisions - Growing residential developments - Easy access to Huntsville and surrounding areas - Quiet, family-oriented environment

items: Big Spring International Park – Downtown green space and events
Monte Sano State Park – Hiking, camping, and scenic overlooks
Huntsville-Madison County Public Library – Storytimes, homeschool resources, and teen programs
